meta.name: Create an AI recruiter copilot for jobs, resumes, and chat with Mistral and Supabase

parameters.content:
## Ai-Recruit Workflow

### How it works

This workflow handles two recruiting intake paths: job creation and resume processing. Job requests are validated, expanded into a job description with skills and experience requirements, checked for bias and quality, optionally improved, then published to Supabase. Resume uploads are validated, extracted, cleaned, parsed into structured candidate profiles, embedded into a vector database, stored as applications, and optionally scored against a job. A separate Copilot chat webhook classifies recruiter questions, gathers the right candidate/job/application context from Supabase or vector search, generates a grounded answer, logs it, and responds.

### Setup steps

- Configure the recruiter intake and Copilot webhook URLs and ensure callers send a routing field that distinguishes job requests from resume uploads.
- Add Mistral API credentials or headers to all LLM and embedding HTTP Request nodes.
- Configure Supabase/Postgres credentials for all database nodes, including pgvector support for candidate embeddings.
- Create or verify the required database tables and SQL functions for jobs, candidates, applications, scores, interview feedback, and chat logs.
- Ensure resume upload requests provide the expected binary file field and accepted MIME types for the file extraction branch.

### Customization

Adjust the job-generation prompts, bias/quality criteria, scoring weights, Copilot intent categories, and Supabase SQL queries to match your recruiting process and database schema.

## Receive recruiter intake

Starts the main recruiter workflow and routes incoming webhook requests to either the job-creation path or resume-processing path.

## Validate job request

Checks whether the job intake payload has the required information and returns an immediate error for invalid job input.

## Generate job details

Uses an LLM to create the job description, required skills, and experience details, then parses the response into structured fields.

## Review job quality

Runs an AI bias and quality check, parses the assessment, and branches based on whether the generated job content passes review.

## Improve failed job

When the job content fails quality checks, asks the LLM to improve the job description and merges the revision before sending it back through review.

## Publish approved job

Saves approved job content to Supabase and responds to the webhook confirming publication.

## Extract clean resume

Validates the uploaded resume file, extracts text from the document, and cleans the text for downstream parsing and embedding.

## Reject invalid file

Returns a webhook response when the uploaded resume file does not pass validation.

## Parse candidate profile

Sends cleaned resume text to the LLM resume parser and converts the result into a structured candidate profile.

## Embed and merge resume

Creates a resume embedding and merges it with the structured candidate profile before database storage.

## Store candidate application

Upserts the candidate into the vector database, updates the stored resume and embedding, and inserts the raw application record.

## Prepare job scoring

Checks whether the resume submission includes a job ID and, when present, fetches the relevant job details for candidate scoring.

## Evaluate candidate fit

Uses an LLM to evaluate the candidate against the job, calculates a weighted score, and saves the score to the application record.

## Confirm resume processed

Sends the final resume-processing response, either after storage alone or after optional job scoring is complete.

## Receive Copilot chat

Starts the Copilot webhook flow and checks whether the request is a simple health check.

## Return health status

Responds immediately to Copilot health-check requests.

## Classify Copilot intent

Classifies the recruiter question with an LLM, parses the intent, and routes the request to the appropriate context-building branch.

## Build search context

Embeds the recruiter question, performs vector search over candidates, and formats retrieved results for a RAG answer.

## Build score context

Fetches candidate and score data from Supabase and formats it for questions about evaluation results.

## Build interview context

Retrieves the candidate profile and job details, then prepares context for generating interview questions.

## Build feedback context

Loads interview feedback from Supabase and formats it for Copilot responses about past interview notes.

## Build general context

Creates a fallback general-purpose context when the recruiter question does not match a specialized Copilot branch.

## Answer and log chat

Generates a grounded Copilot answer using the assembled context, logs the chat to Supabase, and returns the response to the caller.

Return ONLY JSON with keys: skills (array), experience_years (number), experience (array of {company, title, duration}), education (array of {degree, institution, year}), projects (array of strings), certifications (array of strings), achievements (array of strings), summary (string).' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.resume_text } ] }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT id, title, skills, description FROM jobs WHERE id = $1;

UPDATE candidates SET resume_text = $1, embedding = $2::vector
WHERE id = $3;

Location: ' + ($json.body.location || 'Not specified') + '
Experience Level: ' + ($json.body.experience_level || 'Not specified') + '

Review the job description for biased/exclusionary language, unrealistic requirements and clarity. Return ONLY JSON: { "pass": boolean, "quality_score": number (0-100), "issues": array of strings, "suggestions": string }. pass=true only if quality_score >= 75 and no bias issues.' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json) } ] }) }}

const rows = $input.all().map(i => i.json);
return [{ json: { context: 'Top matching candidates:\n' + JSON.stringify(rows), question: $('Parse User Intent').first().json.message } }];

const row = $input.first()?.json || {};
return [{ json: { context: 'Candidate score data:\n' + JSON.stringify(row), question: $('Parse User Intent').first().json.message } }];

parameters.query:
SELECT c.name, c.resume_text, j.title, j.description, j.skills
FROM candidates c
JOIN applications a ON a.candidate_id = c.id
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id
WHERE c.name ILIKE $1 LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode:
const row = $input.first()?.json || {};
return [{ json: { context: 'Candidate + job for interview questions:\n' + JSON.stringify(row), question: $('Parse User Intent').first().json.message } }];

parameters.query:
SELECT c.name, i.feedback, i.rating, i.recommendation
FROM interviews i
JOIN applications a ON a.id = i.application_id
JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id
WHERE c.name ILIKE $1
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 3;
